proof_body:
by
  intro a b c p q hpq h
  have hcont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c) := by fun_prop
  have hex : ∃ x ∈ Set.Ioo p q, a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c = 0 := by
    rcases mul_neg_iff.1 h with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
    · obtain ⟨x, hx, hfx⟩ := intermediate_value_Ioo' hpq.le hcont.continuousOn ⟨h2, h1⟩
      exact ⟨x, hx, hfx⟩
    · obtain ⟨x, hx, hfx⟩ := intermediate_value_Ioo hpq.le hcont.continuousOn ⟨h1, h2⟩
      exact ⟨x, hx, hfx⟩
  obtain ⟨x, ⟨hx1, hx2⟩, hx⟩ := hex
  refine ⟨x, ⟨hx1, hx2, hx⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro y ⟨hy1, hy2, hy⟩
  by_contra hne
  have h1 : a * (y + x) + b = 0 := mul_left_cancel₀ (sub_ne_zero.2 hne) (by linear_combination hy - hx : (y - x) * (a * (y + x) + b) = (y - x) * 0)
  have hb : b = -a * (y + x) := by linarith
  have hc : c = a * y * x := by
    rw [hb] at hx
    linear_combination hx
  subst hb hc
  have e : (a * p ^ 2 + -a * (y + x) * p + a * y * x) * (a * q ^ 2 + -a * (y + x) * q + a * y * x) = a ^ 2 * ((y - p) * (x - p)) * ((q - y) * (q - x)) := by ring
  have h2 : 0 ≤ a ^ 2 * ((y - p) * (x - p)) * ((q - y) * (q - x)) :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg a) (mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith))) (mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith))
  rw [e] at h
  linarith
target_source: ∀ (a b c p q : ℝ), p < q → (a * p ^ 2 + b * p + c) * (a * q ^ 2 + b * q + c) < 0 → ∃! x : ℝ, p < x ∧ x < q ∧ a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c = 0
